name: Toor Dal with Vegetables
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) toor dal, rinsed
1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, drumstick, pumpkin, brinjal)
Tadka: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp mustard seeds, 6 curry leaves, 1 dried chilli, pinch of hing
steps: Pressure-cook the dal with turmeric and 2 cups water for 4 whistles; mash well.
Simmer the vegetables, onion, tomato, tamarind and sambar powder in 1½ cups water for 12 minutes.
Add the mashed dal and simmer for 8 minutes.
Heat the oil for the tadka, crackle the mustard, add curry leaves, chilli and hing, and pour into the sambar.
note: A sambar-style stew with vegetables doing much of the bulk.
